description: The first real declarative Domain Pack (V2 Phase 1B, docs/v2/10-BACKLOG.md BL-018-BL-023) -- proof that berry-specific concepts can be represented as data/configuration rather than hard-coded application assumptions (docs/v2/04-DOMAIN-PACK-SPEC.md). Built entirely from and verified against live V1 data as of 2026-08-14: 162 entities across 9 types, 204 relationships across 9 live predicates (+6 accepted extensions, +1 unused core predicate), 65 entity roles, 10 traits, 9 strategic questions, 120 monitored sources. Does not migrate application behavior to read from this pack -- app/main.py is unchanged; this is the declarative artifact only.
notes: Operationally, only berry-blueberry has live data today, though the entity/relationship/schema layer this pack describes is not blueberry-specific (docs/v2/01-PRODUCT-VISION.md's multi-berry foundation, PRD.md). Two taxonomy files carry unresolved, explicitly-documented open questions rather than silent resolutions, per this task's own instruction: taxonomies/entity-role-vocabulary.json's 'unresolved_synonym_candidates' (10 clusters, e.g. the genetics_* role family) and taxonomies/trait-vocabulary.json's 'unresolved_overlap_candidates' (eating-quality vs. soluble-solids/titratable-acidity). relationship-predicates.json's six accepted extensions (exhibits_claimed_trait, protects, markets, offers, administers_license_for, subsidiary_of) and 'distributes' all have 0 live usage yet -- included because they are schema-valid/accepted, not because any live relationship uses them.
